item: The os helpers' fault names are checked against os, and a getpid replacement the #1602 audit called unreached is shown to be a guard
summary: A misspelt name given to scope_os/scope_os_path/hide_os injects nothing and passes, because the helper replaces with raising=False. One AST test reads every call site (136 literal names, all valid today) and fails on a name that is not an attribute of os, pinned on nine cases, posix-only with its reason; a misspelt name at a real site turns it red. The diagnostics_runs getpid replacement is a guard, proved by a pid-deciding mutant (red with the line, green without), and gets a comment saying so. No src file.
